title: BenchmarkResult
description: Normalized result artifact for a single benchmark run.

env_ref.description: Path to the associated BenchmarkEnvironment JSON file.

transport_mode.description: Transport layer and network path. loopback-h1 results are not equivalent to network-path measurements. TLS on/off is orthogonal and lives in `tls`, not here (e.g. h2c cleartext and h2-over-TLS are both transport_mode=loopback-h2).

tls.description: TLS state of the measured traffic. enabled distinguishes cleartext (h2c/h1) from TLS; the negotiated fields are recorded from the load client when it reports them (e.g. h2load). Provider is the target's choice and is intentionally NOT asserted here.

enabled.description: true if the measured traffic ran over TLS (https endpoint).

protocol.description: Negotiated TLS version, e.g. TLSv1.3 (as reported by the load client).

verified.description: true only if verify-seed.sh exited 0 before this run

tier.description: Exeris product tier. Applies to runtime and product-scoped benchmarks only. For TLS micro benchmarks use 'harness_model' instead.

harness_model.description: TLS micro-benchmark harness contract. Describes the observable transport and allocator model used by the benchmark, not product architecture. Use instead of 'tier' for TLS matrix rows (B/C/D families). Values: 'external-baseline' = third-party reference (JDK SSLEngine, Netty tcnative); 'core-engine' = engine-level benchmark with no full transport wiring (guard paths, state-machine, core JMH); 'fd-owner' = real loopback socket with kernel I/O crossing; 'memory-bio' = in-process inject/drain, no socket, no syscall; 'runtime-harness' = full runtime harness integration probe.

runtime_family.description: Runtime framework/platform identity of the application under test.

artifact_kind.description: Packaging and distribution form of the target artifact.

execution_vm.description: VM executing the artifact at runtime. 'none' for native-image targets with no JVM.

build_mode.description: Compilation and execution strategy of the target artifact.

comparison_axis.description: Report axis classification for this result.

execution_class.description: Execution intent classification for claim guardrails.

claim_scope.description: Claim eligibility classification derived from status and execution intent.

final_reason.description: Canonical postprocess reason code for eligibility/status decisions.

runner_status.description: Canonical runtime runner status for this artifact.

warmup_seconds.description: Legacy warmup duration field. Prefer warmup_window_s for the explicit warmup/measurement/cooldown split.

warmup_window_s.description: Explicit warmup window length in seconds. Load before the measurement window; excluded from steady-state throughput.

measurement_window_s.description: Explicit measurement window length in seconds. Steady-state throughput/latency claims are computed only from this window.

cooldown_window_s.description: Explicit cooldown window length in seconds after the measurement window; excluded from steady-state metrics.

backend_network_mode.description: Container network mode of stateful backends (Postgres/Neo4j/Axon). 'bridge' adds an asymmetric NAT tax across stacks of differing DB-chattiness; pin and record it for cross-stack comparisons. See docs/methodology.md.

contract_id.description: Fixed contract identifier from scenario.json fixed_contracts.

protocol_mode.description: Effective wire protocol resolved for this run (contract pin, else run axis). Mirrors .target.protocol; the (contract, protocol) separation key G3 falls back to.

transport_mode.description: Effective transport for this run (e.g. loopback-h1). h2c collapses to loopback-h2.

result_namespace.description: Relative path namespace for result artifact directory.

startup_iterations.description: Number of independent cold JVM launches aggregated by a cold-start/TTFR run. Each launch is a fresh process spawn; cold-start has high run-to-run variance so a single launch is not publishable.

soak_duration_class.description: Soak duration class. smoke=≤30s exploratory; guard=~10m; regression=~30m; contract=~2h.

metrics.description: Normalized metric values. All latency in microseconds, throughput in req/s.

jmh_alloc_rate_norm_bytes.description: gc.alloc.rate.norm from -prof gc. 0 expected on zero-alloc paths.

steady_state_throughput_rps.description: Throughput computed ONLY from the measurement window (excludes warmup/cooldown). Use this for steady-state claims; throughput_rps may span the whole run.

time_to_peak_s.description: Seconds from load start until per-second throughput first reaches its plateau (e.g. within 5% of the measurement-window mean). Characterizes warmup ramp, NOT steady-state. CAVEAT: only meaningful for open / throughput-seeking drivers. For rate-capped executors (k6 constant-arrival-rate), throughput is pinned to the configured rate, so this detects the arrival-rate step-up, not when the JIT settled — use the JFR C2 compiler overlay (env/jfr-steady-state.jfc) as the real steady-state proof there.

throughput_series.description: Per-second throughput samples reconstructed from the driver's timestamped output. Lets a reader rebuild the warmup curve instead of trusting a single window-averaged number.

phase.description: Phase tag for this bucket, when the driver emits a phase tag.

startup.description: Cold-start and time-to-first-request (TTFR) measurements, aggregated over `iterations` independent JVM launches. t0 is the harness-owned process-spawn instant (the moment the launcher invokes the target's start command); 'ready' = first HTTP 200 from the health endpoint; 'first request' = first HTTP 2xx from the business endpoint after ready. startup_ms is a black-box spawn->health metric: 'ready' semantics differ per framework (Spring 'Started' vs Quarkus 'started' vs Exeris banner vs native-image), so cross-runtime rows MUST carry that caveat and must not be collapsed without it. Because cold-start has high run-to-run variance, a single launch is not publishable — report the aggregate.

iterations.description: Number of independent cold JVM launches aggregated.

measure.description: Definition of the primary startup metric. spawn-to-health = t0 -> first /health 200 (black-box readiness); spawn-to-first-request = t0 -> first business 2xx.

readiness_definition.description: Free-text note on what 'ready' means for this target's framework (e.g. 'health endpoint 200 after Spring context refresh'). Carries the per-framework caveat into the artifact.

first_request_endpoint.description: Business endpoint whose first 2xx defines TTFR.

startup_ms.description: Aggregate of t0->ready durations in milliseconds, over `iterations` launches.

ttfr_ms.description: Aggregate of ready->first-business-2xx durations in milliseconds (first-call penalty: lazy init, cold JIT, pool fill, class loading).

spawn_to_first_request_ms.description: Aggregate of t0->first-business-2xx durations in milliseconds (startup + TTFR end to end).

peak_rss_mb.description: Aggregate of peak resident set size (VmHWM, MiB) reached by the target process from spawn through the first business request, over `iterations` launches. VmHWM is a kernel high-water mark, so one read after the first request captures the window peak.

cpu_to_first_request_s.description: Aggregate of total CPU seconds (utime+stime from /proc/<pid>/stat) consumed by the target process from spawn to the first business 2xx, over `iterations` launches. This is CPU work-to-ready, not instantaneous utilization; divide by spawn_to_first_request_ms for effective cores.

ttfr_curve.description: First-request decay curve. After readiness each launch issues `requests` back-to-back requests on a reused (keepalive) connection; request #1 is the cold spike (connect + cold JIT + lazy init + pool fill) and the tail decays toward steady-state. Lets a reader see the warmup transient, not just the single spike (ttfr_ms).

requests.description: Requests issued per launch to trace the curve.

steady_ms.description: Per-launch steady-state latency (median of the last 25% of the series), aggregated across launches.

spike_ratio_median.description: Median over launches of request#1 latency / steady-state latency. 1.0 = no first-call penalty; higher = sharper spike.

settle_request_median.description: Median over launches of the 1-based request index after which latency stays within 1.2x steady-state for the remainder. How many requests to 'warm up'.

curve_p50_ms.description: Position-wise median latency (ms) across launches: curve_p50_ms[k] = median of request k+1 over all launches. The plottable decay curve.

samples.description: Per-iteration raw measurements, in launch order. Lets a reader recompute the aggregates and see variance instead of trusting a single number.

startup_ms.description: t0 -> ready, milliseconds. null if the launch never became ready.

ttfr_ms.description: ready -> first business 2xx, milliseconds. null if not ready.

spawn_to_first_request_ms.description: t0 -> first business 2xx, milliseconds. null if not ready.

peak_rss_mb.description: Peak RSS (VmHWM, MiB) through first request. null if the pid could not be resolved.

cpu_to_first_request_s.description: CPU seconds (utime+stime) consumed to first request. null if the pid could not be resolved.

latency_series_ms.description: Per-request latency (ms, curl time_total) for this launch's warmup sequence; [0] is the cold spike.

first_request_status.description: HTTP status of the first business response counted as success.

ready.description: false if the launch never became ready within the readiness timeout (excluded from aggregates).

run_track.description: Run track classification for constrained vs unconstrained families.

constrained_family.description: Constrained benchmark family. Required when run_track=constrained.

soak_duration_class.description: Soak duration class for this result. smoke=≤30s exploratory; guard=~10m; regression=~30m; contract=~2h.

degradation_class.description: Observed failure/degradation mode under constraint. Populate when runner_status != success or timeout_rate is elevated.

correctness_under_constraint.description: Axis 1: Correctness under constraint. Populated for constrained-survivability family runs.

total_errors.description: Total error responses (HTTP non-2xx + connection errors).

timeout_count.description: Request timeout count (connection or read timeout).

efficiency_metrics.description: Axis 2: Cost efficiency metrics. Requires valid constrained run evidence with cpu_throttle_ratio.

success_rps_per_effective_cpu.description: successful_rps / (declared_vcpu * (1 - cpu_throttle_ratio)). null when cpu_throttle_ratio unavailable.

success_rps_per_64m_heap.description: successful_rps per 64 MiB of declared heap budget (MaxRAM / 64).

p90_under_budget_us.description: latency_p90_us measured while under declared budget constraint. Copied from metrics.latency_p90_us for constrained runs.

cpu_throttle_ratio.description: nr_throttled / nr_periods from cgroup cpu.stat. Sourced from constrained-execution-evidence.json.

raw_output.description: Full raw stdout from the benchmark tool (optional, for debugging).

sample_stats.description: Aggregate statistics over n independent samples. All values share the unit declared by the containing field name (e.g. *_ms = milliseconds).

n.description: Number of samples contributing to these statistics.
